target: local Apple M4 (G16G), 10 GPU cores, macOS 26.6.2 (25G82)
boundary: public Metal API only; runtime MSL compile of our own carrier kernels; binary-archive splice of our own hand-assembled AGX programs (tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble()); owned shared buffers; every case a fresh process; no Apple binary, archive, BO, or command-stream inspection beyond our own compiled/assembled bytes

raw_schema.00_env.json: environment/provenance receipt (informational git_revision NEVER gated on -- authored_*_sha256 only)
raw_schema.01_results.jsonl: GATED, byte-compared-across-runs: one JSON object per case with keys i,name,item,program,params,oracle,status,pipeline_source,out_hex,observed,match -- no nondeterministic field
raw_schema.01_timing.jsonl: NON-GATED sibling: one JSON object per case with keys i,duration_ms,argv,stdout,stderr -- explicitly NOT required to match across runs
raw_schema.02_dispatch.json: run summary: n_cases, status_counts, match_counts, results_sha256, code hashes
raw_schema.STOP.json: written on any pre-capture or capture-time stop; raw/ left absent if pre-capture

programs_excluded.p4: register-pressure/move program -- COULD NOT be made to produce correct results in the time available (reg_move failed to reliably read a GPR written by a different-family instruction, falsified 3x); reported as a first-class NEGATIVE RESULT in RESULTS.md with raw diagnostic evidence (work/pilotP4/), not captured under the formal two-run gate.

field_matrix_summary.P1: register-index base (implicit, r0-r15 structural cap), float immediates at 0/mid/max-representable(30)/negative-max(-30), integer immediate K at 0/mid/127, one deliberate liveness-bit violation
field_matrix_summary.P2: load idx_off at 0/mid(1000)/max(2047)/first-invalid(2048, masks to 0), elem_size code at 0/1/2/3(baseline)/4, base_slot including the EXP-0083 7-bit mirror (slot+128)
field_matrix_summary.P3: loop trip count at 0/1/3(baseline)/20, if/else natural-select-false/true (data-driven), icmp_pred cond field flip (6->7), one deliberate liveness-bit violation

oracle_source: programs.py build_p1/build_p2/build_p3 -- pure Python, computed independently of any GPU run, using isadb.imm_encode/imm_decode for the minifloat immediate domain and the EXP-0082 HW-validated device_load/device_store address formulas
clean_room: OWN-SHADER + HW-PROBE. Every byte executed is either our own hand-assembled instruction sequence (tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble()) or the compiled form of our own carrier MSL (tools/shdump). No Apple binary introspected.
